text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: Now then, the magic words, please.

text_block_list.name: Student
text_block_list.text:
Here goes... 
"Trick or Treat"!

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
Very well. 
Here you are.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
Passed out the candy. 
...How many more rounds do I have to do?

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
Until our shift ends. 
You are properly exchanging the 
"Trick or Treat" greetings, I trust?

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
By setting an exemplary standard as the 
student 
council, we ensure the students enjoy a 
fulfilling 
event. Do not slack off, understood?

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
...Now, it is about time to restock the 
candy. 
After that, the president's costume 
contest—

text_block_list.name: Student Council Member
text_block_list.text:
A-Air Groove-san! 
Narita Brian-san! Run for your lives~~~~!!

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
What happened? What is the meaning of this 
commotion? 
............And why is your face covered 
in cream?

text_block_list.name: Student Council Member
text_block_list.text:
Ugh... I was ambushed on patrol. 
And they... they declared war...!

text_block_list.name: Student Council Member
text_block_list.text:
"Nobody can stop us! 
We're definitely gonna pull a prank 
on those stuck-up student council snobs 
too!"

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
............Excessive mischief cannot be 
tolerated. 
We must crack down on them immediately—

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
...However, intimidating the other 
students 
with a crackdown goes against our purpose.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
If so, the student council should take 
this on 
and guide them toward "proper mischief."

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: —A sound proposal.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Then for the final role in this "proper 
mischief"... 
namely, serving as the target of their 
prank, 
I shall gladly offer myself.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: The president herself—

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
...Understood. 
Brian, you will be assisting as well.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
Tch. 
Dragged into this after all, huh.

text_block_list.name: Extreme Prankster Horsegirl
text_block_list.text:
Sneaky, sneaky... 
Heheheh, we're here, Student Council!

text_block_list.name: Dangerous Prankster Horsegirl
text_block_list.text: Time to eat some cream pie bazooka...!

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: Hold it.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
You intend to prank the student council, 
correct? 
Then first, describe the nature of your 
prank 
on this application form.

text_block_list.name: Dangerous Prankster Horsegirl
text_block_list.text:
...Huh? 
An a-application form...?!?!?!

text_block_list.name: Extreme Prankster Horsegirl
text_block_list.text:
That ain't a prank at all! 
Take this! Cream pie bazoo—

text_block_list.name: Extreme Prankster Horsegirl
text_block_list.text:
—H-Huh? It's gone?! 
Where'd my bazooka go?!

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: Looking for this?

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
You let go of your weapon far too easily. 
Your fault. 
Confiscated.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
Now, write an alternative proposal. 
Once you do, we will humor you.

text_block_list.name: Dangerous Prankster Horsegirl
text_block_list.text:
Eep...! 
What's your deal?! Getting all high and 
mighty! 
Can you only do goody-two-shoes 
Halloween?!

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: Listen to me.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
I have no intention of denying your 
enthusiasm 
to give someone a genuine surprise.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
I am merely saying that your methods are 
flawed 
and must be corrected.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
Make it something where both the prankster 
and the pranked can end up laughing 
together.

text_block_list.name: Dangerous Prankster Horsegirl
text_block_list.text:
...B-But... 
I've never done a prank like that 
before...

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
...Then you will think of one right here. 
No matter how difficult it proves, as long 
as 
I am here, I will not permit you to give 
up halfway.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: —...They're here.

text_block_list.name: Prankster Horsegirls
text_block_list.text: Tr... Trick or Treat...???

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Unfortunately, I have no candy on hand. 
Now then, do your worst.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Hearing that some students were planning 
extreme 
pranks on the student council, I rushed 
over 
out of concern—

text_block_list.name: Former Prankster Horsegirls
text_block_list.text:
See ya! 
Happy Halloweeeeen!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Confetti is scattered all over the room. 
Symboli Rudolf is brushing off streamers 
that caught on her ears.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Fufu... Ah, to be blasted with confetti 
from a bazooka at point-blank range! 
A truly rare and thrilling experience.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: Fufu... Oh, you came as well?

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: Heh, you had nothing to worry about.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
By the way— 
since you have come, allow me to ask.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
Trick or Treat. 
...Have you prepared yourself to have fun?

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
Fool. What is the very first thing 
one should say on Halloween?

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: Good.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
Here, take this. 
We welcome all who seek to enjoy this day.
